product_metadata.title: Winado 13-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker, 6QT Capacity Multifunction Cooking Pressure Cooker, Stainless Steel & LED Display, Slow Cooker, Rice Cooker, Steamer, Egg Cooker, Warmer, Side Handle (Grey)
features: 【13 IN 1 MULTI-FUNCTION】6qt electric pressure cooker one pot can replace many kitchen utensils, including rice cooker, cake maker, egg cooker, stew pot, food heater, etc.
【MULTIPLE COOKING METHODS】13 customizable programs - rice, porridge, soup, reheat, taste, bake, fish, maintain pressure, stew and other functions to meet your different needs.

【RESERVATION & KEEP WARM】You can put the ingredients into the pot and click to reserve before going to work/school. At the same time, it has the function of keeping warm, so you can also eat hot meals when you get off work/school.

【PRESSURE ADJUSTMENT】During the cooking process, if the air pressure in the pot exceeds the safe pressure, it will automatically reduce the fire power until the air pressure returns to normal, which is a good choice in daily life.

【AUTOMATIC PRESSURE RELIEF & TEMPERATURE CONTROL PROTECTION】The electric pressure cooker will automatically monitor, when the temperature in the pot is higher than the set value, it will automatically cut off the circuit, and automatically release the pressure when the program is completed to protect safety.
description: With our winado pot, you can experience the fully automatic cooking method. You only need to put the ingredients in, press the switch, and you can leave. When you come back, the food has already been cooked, which is safe and fast without the trouble of oily smoke.
